Dear Student,

Please find your Username and Password below. All usernames and passwords are case sensitive.

Student Log-in link : www.tvdsonline.com

Username: { username }

Password: { password }

Cavco Driving Schools would like to Thank you for registering for our California State DMV Approved Online Driver's Ed Course. Our course is 11 Chapters with a quiz at the end of each chapter. You must pass each quiz before you can advance to the next chapter. Once you complete the course we will be electronically notified, and your Completion Certificate will be mailed to you within 2 business days. It typically takes 5-7 days to arrive by mail. Since the DMV requires an original certificate to take your written permit test we cannot email or fax it to you. If you need it sooner than 7 days, you are welcome to pick it up at our Temecula office location. Please call us at 951-587-2587 to let us know that you would like to pick it up. If we do not hear from you your certificate will be mailed within 2 business days of completion.

Please make sure that you "Save and Continue" after completing each quiz and log out after each session or your work may not be saved.

If you have only signed up for Behind the Wheel Lessons, please call our offices to schedule your first lesson and make sure to have your permit on you when you call.

Thank you,

Cavco Driving Schools
